objs.name: document
objs.description: Represents a document within P&R Management; can be a policy, guideline, procedural instruction or work instruction.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached to documents during creation.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Attachment type; content influences the main document versioning.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Non-release attachment such as brief instructions, photos and screenshots that do not require checking and release.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Attachment with content that is subject to release and can trigger versioning of the main document.

evts.name: attachment_of_new_information_object
evts.description: Attaches a new information object to a document during creation.

evts.name: document_release
evts.description: Release process for documents with signatures and approvals.

evts.name: content_editing
evts.description: Editing of document content using an Office component and templates.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Process to extend validity of a document.

evts.name: override
evts.description: Override / AKS process to invalidate or override a document.

evts.name: change_proposals
evts.description: Management of change proposals for a document.

evts.name: distribution
evts.description: Distribution of documents via email or for acknowledgement.

Creates a new document by attaching a new information object
